evidence.summary: Public account-setting documentation states that AUTO uses RFC2833 AVT and falls back to in-band when the far end does not support the RTP event mode. No event range or direction-specific behavior is stated.
Public PBX setup documentation describes a provider-hosted DTMF diagnostic destination. This supports a documented test workflow but does not establish production-route interoperability.

decision.notes: Only account-level in-band fallback is documented. The public material uses the legacy RFC2833 label without an event range, so RFC 4733, SIP INFO, extended keys, route directionality, and end-to-end behavior remain unknown.
